spans.s: AT0207 मयूरकण्ठप्रतिमो mayūrakaṇṭhapratimo When poisonous food is put into fire, color of the flame changes vividly like peacock’s throat.
RS0139 मयूरकण्ठसदृश mayūrakaṇṭhasadṛśa Resembles the color of the throat of peacock
RS0138 मयूरचन्द्रिकाछाय mayūracandrikāchāya Resembling the shade of peacock’s feather
